cases.rationale: Pack-level direct observations with exact configuration, calibration and clock lineage.
Module-level observation is accepted only because module identity is explicitly in the inventory and the asset declares module resolution.
Stale evidence is retained but withheld from usable direct observations.
A valid-shaped BMS estimate remains a BMS-reported value and is never counted as direct sensor evidence.
Missing data is represented as unavailable/null with a reason, never as zero.
The observed subject is not present in the exact batch scope inventory.
Cell-level claims are rejected when the declared maximum observation resolution is pack-level.
Current channel cannot silently carry a voltage unit.
Observation identities must be unique within the batch.
A valid observation cannot reverse monotonic sequence or sample-time order within a sensor/channel/subject stream.
A delay beyond the batch policy cannot be labelled valid.
Direct sensor observations must bind an exact calibration registered in the same batch.
A sample outside its calibration validity interval cannot be marked valid.
Sample time cannot materially exceed receive time under the declared clock uncertainty.
Unavailable readings must use null and never a numeric zero placeholder.
Every quarantined observation requires an explicit reason flag.
A reading with quality flags cannot be classified as valid.
